messages:
samir.k: quick update from profiling run on continuous-batcher today — looks like our decode-rate strata are misaligned with how queues actually form. observed a lot of mixed-latency batches (fast decodes + slow decodes) which kills tail latency.
elaine.t: can you paste the perf numbers?
samir.k: sure — aggregated from 2h test on staging-gpu cluster:
```
> cohort A (prompt < 64 tokens) — mean decode 45 tok/s, p95 latency 60ms
> cohort B (64-256) — mean decode 18 tok/s, p95 latency 220ms
> cohort C (256+) — mean decode 6 tok/s, p95 latency 1.2s
> observed mixed batches p95 latency: ~1.6s (due to slow tail)
```
mike.l: that mixed-batch tail is classic. are KV cache hit rates different across cohorts?
samir.k: yes — cohort C has low KV reuse (different prefixes), cohort A reuses prefixes a lot. KV lookup contention + prefetch thrash on slow beams. KV hit ratio: A 82%, B 46%, C 18%.
ananya: interesting — so batching by prompt-length alone won't fix decode heterogeneity because decode rate correlates with length but also with KV behavior and model decode characteristics.
priyaa: do we have kernel selection telemetry tied to batch composition? e.g., which attention kernels selected when mixed vs homogeneous?
samir.k: added a probe. results: mixed batches often fall back to generic matmul kernels (suboptimal) because sequence-length variance disables faster fused kernels. logs: 
```
kernel_selector.log: chosen_kernel: generic_attention_v2 for batch_id=2345 (seq_lengths=[32,128,512])
```
elaine.t: OK. actionable items?
mike.l: propose we experiment with a two-key classifier at admission: (1) prompt-length cohort, (2) decode-speed estimate (tokens/sec from first N tokens) — then choose queue policy that prefers forming homogeneous decode-speed batches. Also set token-budget targets per cohort so admission doesn't allow huge seq variance.
ananya: also recommend decreasing KV prefetch budget for cohorts with low hit-rate to avoid eviction thrash, e.g., kv_prefetch_tokens: 64 for cohort C, 256 for A.
samir.k: good. I'll sketch config and run AB test tomorrow. sample config: 
```
{"admission_classifier": "decode_speed+length", "buckets": [{"name":"fast","max_len":64,"token_budget":128,"kv_prefetch":256},{"name":"mid","min_len":65,"max_len":256,"token_budget":192,"kv_prefetch":128},{"name":"slow","min_len":257,"token_budget":320,"kv_prefetch":64}], "queue_policy": "prefer_homogeneous_decode_speed"}
```
priyaa: please also add a fallback: if homogeneous batch wait > 50ms, allow mixed join but mark it with priority downgrade so kernel selector can choose safer memory path.
ops-bot: scheduled perf-probe job 'batcher-decode-strata-ab' to run in staging at 2026-03-18T02:00Z :white_check_mark:
samir.k: thanks — I'll push the config to staging under feature flag and attach decode-speed probe to the tracer. will report numbers here after 2 runs. :rocket:
